notes.title: DevLog #10 | Spring Things Update (Controllers, Demo, Mac OS, Linux, etc)
notes.notes:
Hey! Many important things happened in this update! 


It is difficult to imagine a modern platformer without controller support, which is why you can now play Biba`s Adventures using your favorite gamepad.

Also, with this update the game is available for users of Mac OS and Linux platforms.

In addition, now it is not necessary to buy a game to try to play it.
The absolutely free Demo version of the game is now available, but it has some limitations:

 Demo version has only a small part of all levels in the game is available
 In the Demo version in Runner mode - you can only go a short distance to try out the mode
 Demo version couldn't support full save. Achievements and leaderboards do not work, do not worry, everything is available after purchasing the game



Changelist:

 Controllers and gamepads support to control the character and interface
 A free Demo version of the game is available on Steam
 Added animations for interface elements in Selected status
 Changed the startup splash screen
 Disabled vsync by default
 Replaced cursor for optimal size, for Mac OS users
 Changed the implementation of many mechanics, due to the addition of the Demo version

notes.title: DevLog #9 | Kuplinov Update (Checkpoints, tips, etc)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope, you enjoy this update!

Many times i got a requests to add checkpoints into the game.
At first, this was my idea, which was supposed to add complexity to the gameplay. But you have won. After watching some videos, I realized that not everyone wants to go through the game thoroughly, sometimes you just want to look at the main points in the game.

Special for you, i do it...
Специально для таких случаев, я сделал это...
Meet the checkpoints!

The green zone in the form of a circle is the zone in which you can activate the checkpoint by pressing the E button. But it will cost you your coins and you will not be able to pass the level of 3 stars:
https://i.imgur.com/dbxG1sL.png

After activating the checkpoint, the effect of the blast wave will be activated:

https://i.imgur.com/l0ZnCjm.png

If there was no explosion effect, make sure you have enough coins and try to enter the zone again.

Also now chests disappear faster, this nuance is also not everyone liked:

https://i.imgur.com/0pWk3lO.png

An equally important addition, I advise you to re-pass the 1st level, if you do not understand how to jump on walls and ceilings, now educational elements have appeared on it that will help you learn:

https://i.imgur.com/w2O9ujr.png

https://i.imgur.com/3kk0a2I.png

The problem of switching to the level selection menu was fixed, the buttons were located so close that often the level began anew, instead of switching to the menu:

https://i.imgur.com/EXub9Hf.png

In this update there were many more small, but also important things, the character animation was completely rebuilt. This is not very noticeable, but now new opportunities have opened up for me to work with its appearance.
Optimized a lot of mechanics, including significantly reworked character mechanics, and work with coins and chests.

As usual, I suggest watching a video with a brief demonstration of innovations in the game at the bottom of the page!

Changelist:
ADDED:

 Secret things
 Training tips at the first level
 Tips to activating checkpoint
 Animation for checkpoint zone
 Checkpoints for every level
 Localization some texts


CHANGED:

 Distance between buttons at the finish panel
 Optimized character mechanics
 Some changes at the 1 and 7 levels
 Mechanic of coin counting
 Chests mechanics
 Chests disappear faster now

notes.title: DevLog #8 | Juicies after release
notes.notes:
Hi there!! A first 24 hours after release has been left

Using this time, i made some improvements in the game, lets talk more about it:

Now we have new particle effect, when character jump out from wall or ceiling

https://i.imgur.com/8nvLhIl.png

Now, when leaderboard have more players, you can watch you personal best result at the table

https://i.imgur.com/YcNxyON.png

I`m worked at graphics, and now thin column look pretty cool

https://i.imgur.com/TUQsBha.png

Now you must be a leader, because the best player`s nickname and avatar now showing at the main menu

https://i.imgur.com/jQKPtWs.png

*Also, you can see interesting effect, if you click at the best player`s avatar, but it`s a rare effect, and work not for every click.

Now you can find a tips for using hearts at the runner mode

https://i.imgur.com/UUPys2R.png

Now you can go to the main menu after death on the runner mode, escape the select level scene.

https://i.imgur.com/cE1YVOi.png

Also this update includes more less important changes and fixed bugs.

Go to the bottom of this page and look one of trailers :3
